_doc: Small woods outside the forest's own square (VegWoodlots, scripts/world/vegetation/veg_woodlots.gd): FrontierVegetation's layout places the forest only round the fort (veg_layout.gd WORLD, +-396 m); each woodlot here is put into that same layout after it is built (appended, so every forest index before it stays as it was): felled, cut and quarried as the forest is (VegHarvest), drawn with its LODs, its trunks and rocks solid, kept by the save. Free play has them too: they are part of the land (data/world/squares.json gives the open land trees 0.15).

Fields: center [x, z], radii [x, z] (an ellipse), spacing (m between trees on a jittered grid), keep (the share kept inside; thinning toward the rim), species {id: weight} (white_pine, hemlock, oak, maple, birch), max_slope_deg, clear [[x, z, r], ...] (no tree within r: the ground a house goes on), saplings {count, ring [e0, e1] (the ellipse's 0..1 from its middle), species {...}}, rocks [[x, z, kind, scale], ...] (kind: rock_a..rock_e, boulder), props [{kind (log, stump_a, stump_b), at [x, z], yaw (deg), scale}], seed. A tree, sapling or rock in water (WorldRiver) or off the ground there is (FrontierTerrain.in_world) is left out.

woodlots._doc: The stand of oaks and pines on the homestead's ground across the ford (data/story/storylines/two_fires.json places homestead [1000, 100] and cache [1016, 120]; docs/main_story.md 10.1 missions 1-7, Open Land's outro: 'a stand of oaks and pines for timber'): Clearing's three trees, the lean-to's poles, the fire's and the hearth's stone, the house's 32 logs within a short walk of where it goes. Open ground left round the homestead (clear) for the lean-to, the fire and the house (the missions' build steps are within 35-40 m of it). The cache's fallen oak lies at the wood's edge.
